title: A Forward (epsilon, omega) Calculus for Quantum Readout Error and the Classical Post-Processing of Measurement Outcomes
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 19. Applies known forward error-propagation tools (signal-probability analysis, probabilistic transfer matrices, Gallager's parity lemma) to Boolean post-processing of asymmetric quantum readout error, computed per latent assignment, with worked ibm_hanoi syndrome-bit numbers. A two-rate pair does not propagate through Boolean trees as a pair.
